description: Romanian registration indicatives — the 41 county (judeţ) codes plus 'B' for the municipality of Bucharest. HG 1391/2006 art. 23 alin. (1) makes the indicative the first element of every registration number but does not list the codes: art. 26 alin. (1) of Ordinul MAI 1501/2006 puts them in a state standard (SR 13078), which is not published free of charge. The codes are the same as the ISO 3166-2:RO subdivision codes, which ISO derived from the vehicle registration indicatives — that public list is the reference used here.
